title: Let pain widen into the One Light
summary: The wound opens into wonder as the One whose limits cannot be known shines through every creature.
takeaway: Let the ache widen into praise of the Light in all.
lifeApplication: When suffering narrows your sight, pause before forcing an answer and name the One Light present even here.

source.shortMeaning: The shabad turns from pain toward the unknowable One whose Light fills every creature.
source.lifeApplication: When hurt becomes a tunnel, let praise widen the room until the One Light is visible again.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad turns from pain toward the unknowable One whose Light fills every creature.
evidence.turn: Let suffering become a doorway into wonder rather than a wall around the self.
evidence.practicalImplication: When suffering narrows your sight, pause before forcing an answer and name the One Light present even here.
